description_en: Queries the availability detection method of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的可用性检测方式
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-ha-diagnose-config --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHADiagnoseConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

schema.description_en: The details of the response parameters

TcpConnectionType.description_en:
The availability detection method used by Alibaba Cloud for the ApsaraDB RDS instance. Valid values:
LONG: persistent connection.
SHORT: short-lived connection
TcpConnectionType.description_zh:
阿里云对RDS实例的可用性检测方式。返回值：
LONG：长连接
SHORT：短连接
